query: EVALUATE VAR Cutoff = MAX('Snapshot'[ThroughDate]) RETURN ROW("Through", FORMAT(Cutoff, "yyyy-MM-dd"), "Sequence", MAX('Snapshot'[Sequence]), "Observation", FORMAT(MAX('Balances'[Date]), "yyyy-MM-dd"), "Stock", [Finished as observed kg], "Backlog", [Backlog as observed kg], "PreviousBacklog", CALCULATE([Backlog as observed kg], FILTER(ALL('Date'), 'Date'[Date] <= Cutoff - 7)), "DailySales", [Daily sales 30d kg], "Cash", [Cash as observed EUR], "Revenue30", CALCULATE([Revenue EUR], DATESBETWEEN('Date'[Date], Cutoff - 29, Cutoff)), "CashMovement30", CALCULATE([Cash movement EUR], DATESBETWEEN('Date'[Date], Cutoff - 29, Cutoff)), "Sold30", [Sales rolling 30d kg])
